title: Junk Removal Checklist
subtitle: Residential Junk Removal: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Junk Removal Checklist covers removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream. The removal service coordinator records Residential Junk Removal criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Junk Removal Checklist keeps Residential Junk Removal exceptions visible until the removal service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Junk Removal Checklist at residence, removal zone, carry path, loading point, and approved destination. Document removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream identity before Residential Junk Removal begins. Compare removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream findings with stated Residential Junk Removal criteria; route unresolved Residential Junk Removal issues to waste-routing operations reviewer. For Junk Removal Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Junk Removal. Ask waste-routing operations reviewer to review Residential Junk Removal conditions beyond the removal service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Residential Junk Removal, identify responsible parties, residence, removal zone, carry path, loading point, and approved destination, and the linked removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream source.

fields.label: Item category, estimated volume, and removal zone
Access, parking, elevator, property, and destination restriction

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Junk Removal facts for removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Junk Removal inspection checks
items: Item type, count, volume, weight, and disassembly need
Reusable, recyclable, donation, trash, and special-handling stream
Sharp, liquid, battery, electronic, appliance, and unknown-material concern
Wall, floor, stair, door, and landscaping protection
Final sweep, excluded item, and property condition

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Residential Junk Removal, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Removal Service Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unknown, hazardous, regulated, or prohibited material
Item weight or access exceeds safe capability
Property damage or concealed attachment risk
Destination will not accept the material
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Junk Removal when material identity, safe handling, access, property protection, or lawful destination remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Junk Removal proof and route unresolved removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream scope to removal service coordinator.
